The '''Manoe sector''' was located in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="New Territories" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Manoe [[Sector/Legends|sector]] bordered the [[Dohu sector/Legends|Dohu sector]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]], the [[Luuq sector/Legends|Luuq]] and [[Vadigult sector]]s [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]], and the [[Bright Jewel sector/Legends|Bright Jewel sector]] in the [[trailing]] direction. [[Spinward]], the Manoe sector formed a three-way border with the [[Abaar sector/Legends|Abaar]] and [[Tiala sector/Legends|Tiala sectors]].<ref name="Mid Rim" /> The sector retained these borders by [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], when it constituted a part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGtW" />

The northern portion of the Manoe sector contained the [[Manoe system/Legends|Manoe system]], which was linked by a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] to the Dohu and Vadigult sectors.<ref name="EGtW" /> It also contained the [[Grehollo system/Legends|Grehollo system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> home to the small, [[Stone/Legends|rocky]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Captivity]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained the [[Grehollo station]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] base in the Grehollo [[Star system/Legends|system]]. The Empire also used Captivity as a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] by [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiling]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] onto the moon's surface.<ref name="TFtF" />

{{RPG|"[[To Free the Forgotten]]"}}
At one point, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] carried out a successful [[Mission to Captivity|mission]] to liberate the [[Politics/Legends|politically]] important exiles of Captivity.<ref name="TFtF" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Manoe sector was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published as the [[2011]]<ref name="MidRimOriginal">{{SWArchive|url=atlas/midrim/index.html|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}</ref> Online Companion feature [https://web.archive.org/web/20170713024921/http://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim The Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim]&mdash;which placed it in grid squares K-7 and L-7.<ref name="Mid Rim" /> Fry noted on the [[Jedi Council Forums]] of [[TheForce.net]] that the Manoe system was created for "bookkeeping purposes" so that every sector listed in the Online Companion would have at least one corresponding system,<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31618818|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfy]]|date=2011-03-26|time=10:52 PM|quote=Of that list of systems, Gultanna, Manoe, Opitha Tren and Thory Prime were created for the appendix, basically for bookkeeping purposes so every sector would be associated with at least one system. The others are all established worlds.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20191013233754/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-163#post-31618818}}</ref> even though the Online Companion also placed the Grehollo system in the Manoe sector.<ref name="EAOC" />

[[File:Grehollo-Voyages13.png|thumb|right|250px|Map from ''Voyages SF'' 13 depicting the Grehollo system (which would later be placed in the Manoe sector) as part of the Grehollo sector.]]
The Grehollo system, and [[Retroactive continuity|thereby]] the Manoe sector, had made its first full appearance in "[[To Free the Forgotten]]," a [[roleplaying game]] adventure published in the [[1989]] ''[[The Star Wars Rules Companion]]'' for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The adventure was written by [[Greg Gorden]], who developed it from a story by [[Steve Gilbert]] and [[Michael Stern]].<ref name="TFtF" /> "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] roleplaying game source article published in the [[Voyages SF 13|thirteenth issue]] of the ''[[Voyages SF]]'' magazine, placed the Grehollo system in a sector of the [[Grehollo sector|same name]]. According to the article, the system also contained a [[Unidentified prison planet|prison planet]]. Since that article was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process,<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> it is considered non-[[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="UnlicensedStatus">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref>
